defects.actual: READ accepted for forged ADMITTED receipt with foreign root/branch

defects.expected: typed refusal for a forged ADMITTED rent receipt with foreign root/branch
defects.actual: READ accepted; no cash change, but false rent evidence accepted

not_repaired: No patch or repair loop is part of this review.
